# Glossary

The words the rider app uses.
Keep it short.

Extends: tech

Allow: check out our, roof rack

## Dock

What: A powered stand
where one bike is locked.

How: A station is a group of docks.

Avoid:

- rack: Racks are unpowered.
- bay

Good:

- Return the bike to any dock

Links:

- [https://example.com/docs/docks](https://example.com/docs/docks)

## eBike

Why: Riders see it on the frame.

Avoid: electric bike

Case: spelling
